title: tephrosia marginata
intro: Tephrosia marginata, commonly known as the Yellow Leaf or Yellow Pea Bush, is a plant species in the legume family, Fabaceae. The leaves, stems, and roots of this plant have been traditionally used in various cultures to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Tephrosia marginata include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
